title: Ofcom says chatbots that impersonate real and fictional people fall under the UK Online Safety Act
summary: The Guardian reports Ofcom warned tech firms after chatbots imitated Brianna Ghey and Molly Russell.

title: Anthropic, Palantir and AWS partner to provide Claude to US intelligence and defense agencies
summary: Wikipedia's Claude article dates the partnership to November 2024.

title: Biden and Xi affirm that humans, not AI, should control nuclear weapons
summary: Wikipedia's AI safety article records the joint affirmation by the US and Chinese presidents in November 2024.

title: Coalition of Canadian news outlets sues OpenAI over use of their articles to train its models
summary: The outlets allege their articles were used without permission.

title: Morgan Stanley reports Nvidia's Blackwell chip production for 2025 is already sold out
summary: Wikipedia's Nvidia article dates the bank's report to November 2024.

title: Robotics software startup Physical Intelligence raises USD 400m at a USD 2bn valuation
summary: HackerNoon's year review (Spanish edition) lists the Series A round in November 2024.

title: Alibaba releases the Qwen2.5-Coder family of coding models, mostly under Apache 2.0
summary: The 3B variant is under the Qwen Research licence.

title: Alibaba releases QwQ-32B-Preview, an open-weights reasoning model similar to OpenAI's o1
summary: The preview is released under Apache 2.0 with weights only.

title: Mistral releases Pixtral Large and upgrades its Le Chat assistant
summary: Pixtral Large pairs a 1-billion-parameter visual encoder with Mistral Large 2, and Le Chat gains image creation with Black Forest Labs' Flux Pro.

title: DeepSeek releases R1-Lite-Preview, a reasoning model available only through an API and chat interface
summary: DeepSeek said the proprietary preview outperformed OpenAI's o1 on the AIME and MATH benchmarks.

title: Amazon invests a further USD 4bn in Anthropic and AWS becomes its official cloud provider, Reuters reports
summary: The new investment doubles Amazon's total investment in Anthropic.

title: Artists in OpenAI's Sora testing programme reportedly leak the model on Hugging Face; access is pulled within hours
summary: OpenAI would not confirm that the leaked model was Sora, according to the Air Street newsletter dated 1 December.

title: South Korea's government announces deepfake sex crime measures, extending undercover probes to adult victims and requiring 24-hour platform takedowns
summary: Segye Ilbo reports the package also allows confiscation of criminal proceeds before arrest and fines for platforms that fail to stop distribution.
